overview_description.description:
Everyone deserves to feel safe.

Bannerman Security has redefined the world of private security by offering the easiest way for residential, office, retail and other facilities managers to obtain and manage highly-qualified security professionals with recurring and trusted security coverage. As a physical security pioneer, Bannerman has created the world's first ever security marketplace.

At Bannerman, we connect our clients with top security professionals, screening every applicant to ensure that each guard in the Bannerman marketplace has the necessary requirements, certifications, and experience. We do this to ensure our clients receive unparalleled security, safety, and quality throughout their Bannerman experience.

product.name: Bannerman Client Dashboard
product.description: A software platform that allows clients to manage and monitor their security schedules, billing, and guard activities in real time.

product.name: Bannerman Guard App
product.description: A mobile application used by security guards to report incidents, receive instructions, and provide real-time updates to clients and operators.

product.name: Bannerman Operator
product.description: A security operations software used by security guard companies to manage, monitor, and schedule guards and measure their performance.

product.name: Industrial Security Services
product.description: Security guard services specialized for industrial facilities such as manufacturing and storage, providing trained personnel to protect assets and monitor premises.

product.name: Mobile Patrol Security Services
product.description: Security services involving patrols by marked vehicles to monitor multiple locations at scheduled or random times, with GPS tracking and reporting.

product.name: Concierge Security Services
product.description: Security personnel who provide front-desk security, guest reception, and monitoring services while also acting as hosts for buildings such as apartments, hotels, or resorts.
